name: Google Chrome
note: Nothing under `Service Worker` or `Shared Dictionary` is a row. A live registration or an in-memory index points at the removed files, and sites fail to load.
comment: `Database` holds the registration, and the registration addresses script bodies in `ScriptCache`. A running Chrome holds the dictionary index in memory, and removal left `www.reddit.com` blank with `net::ERR_DICTIONARY_LOAD_FAILED` on 19 September 2026.
